title: Mastery Milestones
subtitle: Closed-reference transfer projects between major sections of the course.

milestones.title: Static TaskFlow
milestones.goal: Build an accessible static task manager with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

milestones.title: React TaskFlow Lite
milestones.goal: Rebuild TaskFlow Lite with TypeScript and React while making state ownership explicit.

milestones.title: Full-Stack Skeleton
milestones.goal: Connect a Next.js frontend to a NestJS/Fastify API through an explicit HTTP contract.

milestones.title: Persistent TaskFlow
milestones.goal: Turn the skeleton into a database-backed task system with validated CRUD and professional query behavior.

milestones.title: Secure TaskFlow
milestones.goal: Add verified identity and resource-aware authorization.

milestones.title: Production Frontend
milestones.goal: Build a robust application UI with forms, server-state synchronization, and deliberate state boundaries.

milestones.title: Collaborative TaskFlow
milestones.goal: Add optimistic interactions, realtime reconciliation, and secure file uploads.

milestones.title: Production Engineering
milestones.goal: Prove behavior, harden trust boundaries, diagnose incidents, and optimize with measurements.

milestones.title: Release TaskFlow
milestones.goal: Package, verify, and release TaskFlow through Docker, CI/CD, deployment, and architecture review.

milestones.title: Enterprise Capstone
milestones.goal: Transfer the TaskFlow engineering model to a larger business workflow such as procurement, HRIS, payroll, or inventory.
